Name: Vanilla Forage Fruit Trees for 1.6
Author: Syanide23
Description:
Added a holly tree!

Updates [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16424?tab=posts]Fruit Trees for Vanilla Forage Fruits[/url] to 1.6.

holaitsed's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28661/]Crazy Ed's Fruit Trees[/url] does the same but also changes and adds a lot to my original mod. I figured people might want multiple options so I decided to learn how to update it. If you use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28661/]Crazy Ed's Fruit Trees[/url]﻿ don't use this one! Only use one version.

Adds fruit trees for:

Summer:
Spiceberry - Pierre
Cactus Fruit - Sandy
Coconut - Sandy
Golden Coconut - Island Trader for 10 dragon teeth

Fall:
Wild Plum - Pierre
Hazelnut - Pierre

Winter:
Crystal Fruit - Pierre
Holly Trimming - Pierre

Downloads.Description: Added config to disable unwanted trees.
